name: terminal-rearm-stop-overflow
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
ahdl_include "dut.va"
Vclk (clk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=1 delay=.08n period=.11n width=.04n rise=5p fall=5p
Vrst (rst 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 1 0.47n 1 0.49n 0 35.37n 0]
Vstart (start 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 1.01n 0 1.03n 1 1.09n 1 1.11n 0 3.41n 0 3.43n 1 3.49n 1 3.51n 0 6.41n 0 6.43n 1 6.49n 1 6.51n 0 35.37n 0]
Vstop (stop 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 2.2n 0 2.22n 1 2.28n 1 2.3n 0 5.8n 0 5.82n 1 5.88n 1 5.9n 0 35.37n 0]
XM (start stop clk rst code_0 code_1 code_2 code_3 code_4 code_5 code_6 code_7 valid overflow) tdc_meter
tran tran stop=35n maxstep=2p
save start stop clk rst code_0 code_1 code_2 code_3 code_4 code_5 code_6 code_7 valid overflow
